如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    蓝一阳想到今天新交的哥们给看的沐如岚的相片，那是他第一次见她，虽然在同一个学校，沐如岚的名声也很高，但是毕竟是学生会长，很少会在课间时候校园里乱逛，而且还不在一个年级，沐如岚是高三生，他是高二生。
所以他一直对这个女孩很好奇，当看到她的相片的时候，他惊了一下，觉得这女孩气质很好，笑容很温暖，但是却没看出来，有什么值得让他们那么爱她了，很夸张不是吗？他听到了无数次，他们说：和沐如岚接触过的人，都会喜欢她，他们人人都爱她。
这不夸张吗？超级夸张好不好？比他见到爷爷一夜七次郎还夸张不可信，即使是人民币都有人嫌它臭呢，他才不相信呢，但是不知道怎么了，他就冒出了那么一句，“和她做的感觉，一定不错。”他想，如果有人问他为什么，他会回：“因为一般看起来越清纯矜持的女人，在床上一般都越浪荡。爷爷告诉我的。”只可惜，他没等来别人问，等来了沐如森和沐如霖的拳头。
想到了沐如岚方才就这样揭出他说过的话，方才怔着没反应过来，这会儿倒是觉得浑身不自在，尴尬极了。
沐如岚弄好了东西，抬头，就见到蓝一阳一副便秘表情的看着她，鼻孔下面有两管鼻血。
“……”
“我走了。”沐如岚把盖子扔进垃圾桶，道。
“喂。”蓝一阳鼻音浓重的声音响了起来。
沐如岚回头看他，眼中的严厉已经没那么明显了，却还是有着几分，看得蓝一阳浑身别扭。
沐如岚看了他一会儿，蓝一阳也没说个什么东西出来，于是沐如岚直接走进厕所里，戴着放在厕所里的塑胶手套，拿了个壶出来。
蓝一阳费力的抬起脑袋看，“你干什么？”
沐如岚拿着壶靠近他，“不是要上厕所么？”
蓝一阳惊讶了下，还没说出什么，就见沐如岚竟然掀开他盖着肚子的被子，解他的裤头，蓝一阳吓得连忙伸出左手拍掉她的手，捂住裤裆处，“你干什么？！”
“帮你把尿啊。”
蓝一阳涨红了脸瞪着沐如岚，脸色变幻不断，看着沐如岚一副开始有点不耐的眼神，他脑子一乱，“你怎么不干脆帮我把屎也把了？！”
沐如岚眉头一皱，眼神又渐渐严厉了起来，“蓝同学，我想我有必要告诉你，我的忍耐也是有限度的。”
沐如岚上辈子就是一个倔强到天都压在她背上，她也绝对不向任何人低头的人，耐性也不算多好否则不会就这么玩不过白素情，这辈子就算扭曲了变态了，她的耐性也算不得多好，而当她对你耐性特别特别好的时候，你才要小心了，这绝对是危险的信号，因为她啊……只对她想要做成人偶的人，耐性特别好。
蓝一阳，上辈子没得罪她，这辈子也算不上得罪，她就是在睚眦必报也不会对会向她吼说吃苹果要带皮的小孩下手……当然，如果他再过分一点点的话，就不一定了。
一看沐如岚严厉起来的眼神，蓝一阳便懊恼了，他本意不是这样的，可是又不知道怎么办，于是他看到沐如岚把东西都放回厕所，走出门的时候粗粗的吼了声，“我明天要喝鸡汤！”
沐如岚脚步微顿，下颚微含，嘴角勾起一抹温暖柔和的微笑，乌黑的发虽然依旧潺潺滑下，但是那一瞬间，蓝一阳却捕捉到了。

病房门轻轻的被带上，蓝一阳都没回神，好一会儿，等他回神了，味道香喷喷的食欲大开的味道，眼底莫名的便盛了笑意，只是下一秒，他脸色又臭了。
“他妈就不能照顾照顾老子受伤的右手吗？！都放在右手边是要闹哪样啊魂淡！”
“回家吧。海叔。”沐如岚微笑的对陈海道。
陈海见沐如岚心情好，他便也心情好，放着沐如岚喜欢的交响曲，车子缓缓的朝沐家驶去。
沐如岚靠在车上，看着窗外飞逝而过的风景，嘴角笑容很美很温暖，仿佛在她眼中，这个世界是如此的美好。
而事实上，是很美好，重生后的世界，比前世美好上了千万倍呢。
蓝一阳，这个名字，沐如岚隐约的有点印象，后面仔细想了想，才猛然想起，上一世那国际都如雷贯耳的传说从来没有他打不赢的官司的蓝大律师么？从哈佛法学院毕业的高材生，一进律师界便名声鹊起，这是个天才，律师界的新生传奇，因为在她死的时候，他才二十三岁，进入律师界一年半，却已经打过三场人称最不可能打赢的官司，打赢了三场前所未有的漂亮的胜仗。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Lan Yiyang thought of the photo of Mu Rulan shown by his new friend today. It was the first time he met her. Although she was in the same school, Mu Rulan also had a high reputation, but she was the student council president after all and rarely wandered around the campus during recess. Moreover, she was not in the same grade. Mu Rulan was a senior in high school and he was a sophomore in high school.
So he had always been curious about this girl. When he saw her photo, he was shocked. He felt that the girl had a very good temperament and a warm smile, but he didn't see anything that made them love her so much. It was exaggerated, wasn't it? He heard it countless times, they said: Everyone who comes in contact with Mu Rulan will like her, everyone loves her.
Isn't this an exaggeration? Super exaggerated, okay? It was even more exaggerated and unbelievable than when he saw his grandfather seven times in one night. Even if it was RMB, some people thought it smelled bad, so he didn't believe it. But for some reason, he just said, "It must feel good to do it with her." He thought, If someone asked him why, he would reply: "Because generally women who look more pure and reserved are generally more promiscuous in bed. Grandpa told me." Unfortunately, before anyone could ask, he waited for the fists of Mu Rushen and Mu Rulin.
Thinking of Mu Rulan revealing what he had just said, she was stunned and didn't react, but now she felt uncomfortable and extremely embarrassed.
After Mu Rulan finished getting the things done, she looked up and saw Lan Yiyang looking at her with a constipated expression. There were two tubes of nosebleeds under his nostrils.
"..."
"I'm leaving." Mu Rulan threw the lid into the trash can and said.
"Hello." Lan Yiyang's nasal voice sounded.
Mu Rulan looked back at him, the sternness in her eyes was no longer so obvious, but there was still a bit of it, which made Lan Yiyang feel awkward.
Mu Rulan looked at him for a while, but Lan Yiyang didn't say anything, so Mu Rulan walked directly into the toilet, put on the plastic gloves placed in the toilet, and took out a pot.
Lan Yiyang raised his head with difficulty and looked, "What are you doing?"
Mu Rulan approached him with a pot, "Don't you need to go to the toilet?"
Lan Yiyang was surprised. Before he could say anything, he saw Mu Rulan lift the quilt covering his belly and unbutton his pants. Lan Yiyang was so frightened that he quickly stretched out his left hand to slap her hand away and covered his crotch, "What are you doing?!"
"Help you pee."
Lan Yiyang's face flushed and he stared at Mu Rulan, his face changing constantly. Looking at Mu Rulan's eyes that were starting to look a little impatient, his mind was confused, "Why don't you just take the shit out of me?!"
Mu Rulan frowned, and her eyes gradually became stern again, "Classmate Lan, I think I need to tell you that my patience has its limits."
In her last life, Mu Rulan was a stubborn person with the world on her back. She would never bow to anyone. Her patience was not very good, otherwise she would not be able to play with Bai Suqing. Even if she is twisted and perverted in this life, her patience is not very good. And when she is particularly patient with you, you have to be careful. This is definitely a danger signal, because she... is only very patient with people she wants to make into dolls.
Lan Yiyang, who had never offended her in his previous life, could not be considered offended in this life. Even if she was determined to retaliate, she would not attack a child who yelled at her to eat apples with the skin on... Of course, if he went too far, it wouldn't necessarily be the case.
Seeing Mu Rulan's stern eyes, Lan Yiyang became annoyed. He didn't mean to do this, but he didn't know what to do, so he saw Mu Rulan put everything back in the toilet, and when he walked out of the door, he yelled, "I want to drink chicken soup tomorrow!"
Mu Rulan paused slightly, held her chin slightly, and raised a warm and soft smile at the corner of her mouth. Although her black hair was still flowing,But at that moment, Lan Yiyang captured it.
The door to the ward was gently closed, and Lan Yiyang didn't come back to his senses. After a while, when he came back to his senses, he could see the delicious smell that whetted his appetite, and his eyes filled with smiles for no reason, but the next second, his face turned foul again.
"Can't you fucking take care of my injured right hand?! What kind of trouble would you make if you put it on the right hand?"
"Go home, Uncle Hai." Mu Rulan said to Chen Hai with a smile.
When Chen Hai saw that Mu Rulan was in a good mood, he was also in a good mood. He played Mu Rulan's favorite symphony and the car drove slowly towards Mu's house.
Mu Rulan leaned on the car and looked at the scenery passing by outside the window. The smile on her lips was beautiful and warm, as if the world was so beautiful in her eyes.
In fact, it is very beautiful. The world after rebirth is thousands of times more beautiful than the previous life.
Lan Yiyang, this name, Mu Rulan had a vague impression of. After thinking about it carefully, she suddenly remembered that in the previous life, there was never a lawyer Lan who had a lawsuit that he could not win. A top student who graduated from Harvard Law School, he became famous as soon as he entered the legal profession. He was a genius and a new legend in the legal profession, because when she died, he was only twenty-three years old. He had been in the legal profession for a year and a half, but he had already fought three lawsuits that were said to be the least likely to be won, and won three unprecedented and beautiful victories.
